methods.name: UK Digital Media Expert Survey (IAS × YouGov)
methods.description: Integral Ad Science partnered with YouGov to survey U.K. digital-media experts from both the buy- and sell-sides to understand the challenges and opportunities they foresee for 2026. Fieldwork was conducted in October 2025 and captured responses from 220 professionals who actively use programmatic advertising (Advertisers = 84, Agencies = 81, Publishers/Platforms = 55).
methods.citation: IAS 2026 Industry Pulse Report – Study Design & Objectives
